name: Gothic Love
source:
I am a princess, currently looking for marriage,
but I can't find a prince who's around the same age as me!
　
The only single prince I did manage to find
lives in a country with...
　
...a 0% rate of survival!
It's full of creepy creatures,
running rampant even as we speak?!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5496]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我是一位正在寻找结婚对象的公主，
可就是找不到和我年龄相仿的王子！
　
我好不容易找到的唯一一位单身王子，
住在一个……
　
……生存率为0%的国家！
那里到处都是可怕的怪物，
现在还在横冲直撞？！

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5496]Freem![/url]]
